title: mattpocock/skills
claim: mattpocock/skills — Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
why_good: A well-known TypeScript educator open-sourced his personal agent 'skills' directory — strong distribution, but it's a curated file set, not a product.
value: Hard to monetize directly; the real business would be a paid, quality-controlled 'skills registry/marketplace' with maintenance — which this isn't yet.
risk: It's a content collection, not a company: near-zero moat, no usage/retention, and skill packs get absorbed straight into the agent platforms.
